LEDGER_SCHEMA_AND_APPEND_ONLY.decision: Every successful mutation appends one immutable ledger row containing transaction_id, idempotency_key, user_id, direction, amount, balance_before, balance_after, reason_code, source, original_transaction_id and created_at. Existing rows are never updated or deleted.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT_POLICY.decision: Every mutation requires a stable idempotency_key. Same key plus identical canonical payload returns the original transaction; same key with changed payload fails as conflict without mutation.

COMPENSATION_EXACT_ONCE_POLICY.decision: Compensation is a new opposite-direction ledger transaction linked to exactly one original transaction. Repeating the same compensation key replays; a second distinct compensation for an already compensated original is rejected. Compensation of compensation is forbidden.

NON_NEGATIVE_AND_CLAMP_POLICY.decision: Canonical debit is fail-closed and never clamps. Administrative removal may calculate a clamped requested amount before issuing one explicit debit command; the wallet itself still rejects insufficient balance and never becomes negative.

TRANSACTION_AND_COMMIT_OWNERSHIP.decision: CrystalWalletLedgerService mutates wallet and appends ledger through a caller-supplied Unit of Work. The application use case owns exactly one commit; every failure rolls back balance, ledger and consumer mutation together.

CONSUMER_ALLOWLIST_AND_SHADOW_OWNERS.decision: Production consumers use only CrystalWalletLedgerService. Allowed categories are admin, crystal_shop, bag_expansion, premium_purchase, daily_or_milestone_reward, refund and compensation. Direct SQL/setter mutation, DEV/presentation ownership and a second wallet owner are forbidden.
